description: Turn ChatGPT conversations and documents into a standard Obsidian Vault ZIP with linked Markdown and built-in usage guides.

defaultPrompt: Turn this conversation into a standard Obsidian Vault ZIP. / 把這段聊天整理成標準 Obsidian Vault ZIP。
Format these generated documents and export them to Obsidian. / 把生成文件格式化並匯出給 Obsidian。
Build a linked knowledge graph and include mobile and desktop ZIP instructions. / 建立關聯知識圖譜，並附上手機與電腦 ZIP 使用說明。
interface.displayName: EW Knowledge Forge / 具象知識鍛造器
interface.longDescription: EW Embodied Knowledge Forge turns ChatGPT conversations and documents into a standard Obsidian Vault ZIP containing structured, linked, versioned Markdown plus English and Traditional Chinese usage guides. Users only download, unzip, and open the folder as a Vault—no Obsidian community plugin or separate OpenAI API key is required. / 具象知識鍛造器由 ChatGPT 負責理解、分類、建立關聯與版本，輸出標準 Obsidian Vault ZIP，內含中英文使用說明。使用者只需下載、解壓縮並將資料夾作為 Vault 開啟，不必安裝 Obsidian 外掛，也無須另外申請 API 金鑰。

name: ew-obsidian-knowledge-forge
